title: ProntoPC Totem Contract
description: A continuity waypoint left by one session for the next cold-start instance: what was done to the code AT THIS POINT, hash-bound to the actual files so a future instance re-hashes and detects drift instead of inheriting a stale picture. A Totem is a true sign only while its file hashes still match the tree; a mismatch means the code moved and the Totem must be re-verified, not trusted. Append-only: never edit a past Totem, add a new one.

totem_id.description: Trunk form TOTEM-0001 (legacy shared file), or lane form TOTEM-<LANE>-0040 (a per-writer shard, e.g. TOTEM-C-0040). Lane numbers are local to the lane; never compare numbers across lanes — order the ledger by utc.

lane.description: The writer's lane for shard entries (e.g. 'claude', 'codex'), matching the shard file totems.<lane>.jsonl. Absent on legacy trunk entries.

entry_marker.description: Legacy inline marker retained for historical append-only records. New-append detection and display are owned by the Totem New-Append Satellite.

session_ref.description: The session/transcript this Totem was written from, for tracing back to the reasoning.

summary.description: What was done code-wise at this point, in one or two sentences.

actions.description: The concrete things done, most load-bearing first.

files.description: The referent binding. Each file this Totem claims to have created/modified, with the SHA-256 of its bytes at write time.

verify_on_resume.description: The exact command a future instance runs to confirm this Totem still holds against the live tree.

next_gated_step.description: The single next action, so a cold-start instance knows where to pick up without guessing.
